Japan's real, PPP-adjusted GDP per capita rose by about 20 fold between 1950 and 2016. Maddison-style estimates put it at roughly $2,000–3,000 in 1950 and about $38,000 in 2016, which is a 12- to 19-fold rise. Of the two options, 20 fold is much closer than 5 fold. I'm working from memory and haven't checked the dataset.

CONFIDENCE: 80
